messages:
Priya Narang: heads up  compressed QBR for Horizon Systems next Wed. Tight 15min slot with SVP Ops. Need: 1-slide exec asks, current onboarding gates, renewal health signal, owners. doc: https://tiny.redwood/horizon-qbr

Samir Patel: I can pull the last 30d active seats and engagement funnel. Will paste charts into slide 3.

Evelyn Wu: Renewal health = yellow. Primary risks: no analytics export, two unresolved onboarding tickets, and token usage dip. Recommend asking for short-term usage credits + analytics access priority.

Priya Narang: @Evelyn please add the renewal score and top 2 mitigation options under slide 2.

Jonah Blake: Invites out to SVP Ops and Head of Eng. We should have one clear ask: decision point + go/no-go for pilot extension. I'll make slide 1 simple.

Carmen Li: I volunteer to run a 3-day enablement blitz to unblock seats. Scope: credential mapping, demo walkthrough, post-demo checklist. Need approval for 8 SE-hours.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deck revision deadline set to 2025-03-03 17:00 for channel review.

Samir Patel: Added engagement funnel and seat heatmap. Notable: 18% seat churn in week 2 of onboarding.

Evelyn Wu: Onboarding tickets: #457 (claim mapping) assigned to Horizon infra, ETA Thu. #462 (analytics export) awaiting product escalation; escalation raised.

Priya Narang: Drafting exec asks (put these in doc, slide 1):
```
- Approve 6-week pilot extension with usage credits
- Prioritize analytics export and grant temporary analytics access
- Greenlight 8 SE-hours for enablement blitz
```

Jonah Blake: I trimmed wording: "Approve 6-week pilot + temporary credits to demonstrate retention impact." Put it in the doc.

Carmen Li: I'll build the enablement runbook and share templates by Tue EOD.

Samir Patel: Quick table added: expected retention delta + ARR impact if pilot approved. Assumptions noted.

Evelyn Wu: Recommend we include a short customer quote slide (live feedback). Priya can you pull last week's NPS comment?

Priya Narang: Pulled NPS comment and added under slide 4. Also added the single-sentence "ask for exec" on slide 1: "Approve pilot extension and allocate enablement resources."

Jonah Blake: Dry run scheduled Tue 08:45 (10 minutes). Please be concise.

Carmen Li: Acknowledged. I'll attend and present the enablement plan.

Samir Patel: I'll be on for the data slide.

Priya Narang: Thanks team. Final deck to be shared by EOD Tue. If any blockers surface, drop them here. :rocket:
